full_judgment: 2. The relevant facts, for disposal of this petition, in short, are that one Basanta Kumari Saha executed a will on 12.12.1984 in favour of Pijush Kumer Dev appointing him to be the Sehait of the family Deity Sree Sree lswar Gopal Jew Dev Bigraha Thakur. Basanta Kumari Saha died on 03.07.1985. Pijush Kumer then filed an application under Section 276 of Succession Act before the Subordinate Judge and District Delegate, Natore for getting probate. The said application was registered as Miscellaneous Case No.66 of 1986. One Ganendra Nath Roy filed  objection in the said Miscellaneous Case on 10.03.1987. Then the case was transferred in the Court of District Judge, Natore and was renumbered as Title Suit No.02 of 1987. Pijush Kumer died leaving his son Pallob. The plaintiff examined four witnesses. After examination of 4 witnesses, Ganendra Roy filed a fresh written objection which was accepted by the learned District Judge on 09.04.1997. Against the said order dated 09.04.1997, the petitioner filed the aforesaid appeal.
